book.name: YIPIRUW
book.title: Sukwudaal Maaj YIPIRUW Kristen Duw Takwak

content: Kristen duw taakw dayadiy kwurdanadiy yawiy
Gwur gwuradiy kapa Kristen gwalugwa duw takwak kip mawul yijibir ada.

Wukin akaray kipa duw takwaam wakaray kwur-kwurik gwuradiy wiyaar. Aw tayir nuwukadiy duw kipa duw dayadiy wiyaar wakaray kwurkuw, ginyir day sitakiradaal day kipa duw maa. Aw day God diki maaj kardadiy duw tidiy.

Adiy kalabus im kwanadiy duw takwak mawul awuk, dayawa tamiy nak kwanapik kwagwuraala. Adiy Jisas Krais diki danik tikuw jawjaay kwurin tinadiy duw takwak mawul awuk, dayawa jawjaay kwurnapik kwurgwuraala.

Duw takwaam kira-kwadanadiy sukw, aal viyakita jaava. Duw day dayadiy kapa takwadika tikuw, nyigbay kwakwadiy. Aw taakw dayabab atawa dayadiy kapa lanugwawa kwakwadiy. Adiy miyawa yabim vaal yiyi yiya-kwanadiy duw takwawa, adiy duw day nuwukadiy duw dayadiy takwaam vaal yikwanadiywa, aw adiy taakw day nuwukadiy taakw dayadiy lanugwawa vaal yikwanadiywa, God atampika duw takwaam kotiy-kidadiy.
God nyanak bwu wadil,

content.text: “Wun gwuraam samab wap maa. Awarab wun gwuraam samab viyamay maa.”

content: Alik tikuw, samab sanak yikwana mawul gwuradiy mawulaam van tiliba. Aw gwur kip rakarak ada adiy gwuraam rinadiy javik.
God nyanak viyamay maardalik tikuw, aw nyan rivinadiyan wawak,

content.text: “God wunaam sugwiyaan kwurdalik tikuw, alik wun yaag maa adiy duw taakw wunaam kwurkidanadiy javik.”

content: Adiy tayir gwuradiy gwurak God diki maaj kalivadiy sapakwa nyanugwak wukin akaray. Dayadiy kwayidadiy sukwawa kiyadadiy kiyak wukikuw, dayadiy Jisas Kraisak wukijibir tidadiy mawula pik akwur ya.
Aw Jisas Krais di kip kwakwanaad. Di akis warapiy-kwanaad tayir aw kitaan ab aw nyanyi nyanyi.

Alik tikuw, gwur mayaakw kwawayik nuwukadiy kipa duw dayadiy kapaba kaliva-kwadanadiy maaj kapaba yabir gwuraam liyliyik. Aw li nyan nuwukadiy kamnaagw lo majib wuki-kibanadiy, a jaav samab rav maa nyanadiy mawulaam sugwiyaan kwur-kwurik ap tidakikik. Aw tayir adiy majib wukidiy duw takwaam sugwiyaan maa kwar. Aw God diki sukwasukw kwurkwana mawul, aal nyanadiy mawulaam sugwiyaan kwurkwaladiy ap tidakikik.

Adi maap tidi miyaam Jisas Krais vaal kwurid nyanadiy valik. Aw li duw taakw kip day dayadiy vaal Godak kwurjibira-kidanadiy Mawsis diki lo walil pikaar nyigilin tidakikik, aw Jisas Krais diki kwurdil yawiy dayaam sugwiyaan kwar maa.

Aw adiy Juw dayadi Mwiya Yitaypika Pris animal dayadi nyikiy kwurkuw, God dikidi wiyaam Mwiya Kapaba Tamiyaar karay-kwanaad duw taakw dayadiy valik vaal kwurik. Aw adiy animal dayadiy amwiy day kipa kawaam yiy wapataka-kwadanadiy.
A javik tikuw, Jisas kipa kawa tipawa kiyaad duw taakw dayadiy valik yibwiyik di dikidi kapa nyikiyir.

Alik nyan Juw dayadiy Godak gaba maaj sukwu-kwanadiy sukwawa nyanadiy tayir kwurbadiy kupwarapa sukw wapakuw, Jisas Krais wukin patin tikuw, diki danik tikuw, diki pik duw taakw dayadiy sapisa jiki maaj kwurnaak.

Kidi kupw, aad nyanadi nyanyi kwaya-kibanadi tip maa. Aw nyan kavin kwakwanadiyan nikidi yakinadi tipak. Alik tikuw, Jisas Krais diki danik tikuw, nyan mayaakw kwanaak duw taakw nyanak sapisa maaj kwur-kwurik nyan adiy sukw wapakuw.
Nyan vaal kwur-yaay, nyan nyanadiy wayapiy si maaj Jisas Kraisaar Godak nyanyi kwiy-naak. Aw nyan kitawa yawiy kwurkwabana God dikidi si yakisuwtakataay duw taakw dayadiy mwutamaam.
Nyan vaal kwur-yaay, rikarik-awa sugwiyaan nyanadiy javir duw takwak kwurnaak. Atampika nuwukadiy duw takwak nyanadiy nyawa jaav kwiykwabana yawiy mwugiy-kwalaad God rakarak tidikikik.

Adiy God dikidi gwalugwum gwuraam van tikwanadiy duw dayadiy majib awuk. Aw gwuradiy maaj dayadiy majim kakildaba. God adiy duw tasakwu-dilik tikuw dayadiy yawiy kwur-kwurik, day yawiy kwur-kwanadiy God diki dayak mayaakw kwakida mayaakw kwur-kwurik. Alik tikuw, li gwur dayadiy majik wuki-kigwura, gwur mwugiy-kigwuradiy dayadiy mawul rakarak tikinadiy dayadiy yawiyik. Gwur mwugiy-way dayadiy mawul sarmabap tikinadiy. Aw li gwur atawa kwurkigwura atampika mawul samab gwuraam sugwiyaan kwar maa.
Gwur kip nyana danik tikuw, Godak bas sijibiran ada. Nyan viyakita mwiyir tikwanadiy yawiyda kwurik tibanalik tikuw, aw nyan mwiyir lakwu-kwabana nyanadiy mawul mwiyir tugwaam naan tikwanadiy.
Wun gwurak bas sidika sinadiwun gwur Godak bas sigwurkikik di mwugiy-kidadiwun aal simiy ti maa gwurak yatuwkikik.
Pol Godak bas sidid adiy Kristen duw takwak.

Adi dikidiy duw taakw dayadiy mawul kwusida-takaan tidakikik mwugiy-kwanadi God Jisas Krais dikidi nyikiyir di diki aban lakatiydil kip nyanyi nyanyi tijibir tiyalikik. Jisas Krais God diki majib wukikuw, kiyadilik tikuw, God tasakwudid Taay Yitaypika Galab Kwurkwanadi Duw dikidi gwalugwa kidiy duw takwak tidikikik, dikim kirapitakakuw.

Wun kidi Godak bas situwaad di gwuraam mwugiy-kidadiygwur mwiyir rivigwurkik diki mawul waladiy yawiy kwurkwurik. Wun bas situwaad ab di mwugiy-kidadiygwur di diki mawul wala pika yawiy Jisas Krais diki apaar kwurgwurkik. Nyan kidi Jisas Krais dikidi saam yakisuwtaka-naak. Mwiya maaja.
Polawa dikidiy kapa nyanugw wayapiy maaj dayak wayakidiy.

Wunadiy gwalugwa duw taakw, ki gwura sukwutuwil lapa nyig, a simiy maaj maa. Alik tikuw, wun bas situwadiygwur wun gwur yarakara mawulawa ki maaj wukigwurkik nyanyi nyanyi. Ki maaj ap kwiykina gwuradiy mawulaam.

Wun gwur lakwu-gwurkik, day nyanadi gwalugwa duw, Timotiy-aam kalabus im kwadik, bwutaay kugwayakidaad. Aw li wun ki tip wap maarkituwa nibway, aw di kilir taay yakida, wun kwurjibir kariya-kituwaad wunawa nakamwiyib gwurak yatuwik.
Wuna mawul yiladiy wayapiy maaj gwuradiy sapakwa nyanugwawa abab God dikidiy duw takwak aw. Aw nyanadiy Yitaliy jaka tipa kidiy kapa nyanugw ab dayadiy wayapiy sidanadiy maaj gwurak wayaki-danadiy.
Wun Godak bas situwaad diki sukwasukw kwurkwana mawul gwur ababawa rilikikik.
